purpose: Close the new-source application-entry gap: static learning, current detections, completed-window resolution, tracking, CSV and report model. No new mechanism or product acceptance.

source.acquisition: Public unauthenticated video-only MP4, yt-dlp 2026.8.19, format 136, TLS verified using /etc/ssl/cert.pem. No project dependency added.
source.storage: Original download bytes moved once to an existing ignored media path; no re-encode, cut, audio or repository video upload.
source.independence: New exposed source candidate; not a reserved holdout. Whole-source independence is not certified by distinct file bytes.
source.metadata_scope: Curated public metadata only; temporary signed media URLs and full downloader metadata are not committed.

geometry_scope: Reuse the isolated-frame geometry, explicitly extended only to these three already retained native frames. This is a controlled diagnostic fixture, not an operator-approved continuous Recipe.
fixture_scope: Controlled UNKNOWN_REVIEW start. HOLD_BELOW_ZERO exercises downstream assembly without inventing compressor start; zero line is an uncalibrated fixture. Operating judgment and recovery timing are NOT_EVALUATED.
settings: Unmodified DetectorSettings defaults; no exclusions, templates, references, Local XY or detector options.
initial_state_authority: Harness confirmation only, not a new human physical-state judgment. Prior isolated baseline used AUTO; differences cannot be attributed solely to temporal/static context.

window.decode_scope: Existing coordinator learns static artifacts from start/middle/end and decodes the same three analysis targets, six read_at calls per fresh run. No window expansion after outcomes.

comparison: Fresh processes. Exact raw/completed detection equality, tracking/report models after removing run_id only, decoded source bytes and all CSV cells except run_id. Preserve all observations and full candidate trace, including failures.

truth_scope.limits: Only this reviewed anchor is scored by interval distance. No unique edge, neighboring-frame truth, source pass rate or full episode qualification.

retention: Complete raw/completed/tracking/report/lineage/Foam records, CSV and FULL trace assets; lossless compression and byte-identical payload aliasing allowed with hashes.
stop: Stop on input/source-frame mismatch, unexpected decode/count, recipe mutation, equality failure or resource failure. Do not tune geometry, thresholds, cadence, window, state or judgment rule after outcomes.
